Asset type: transparent game prop sprite for Charlie Party Cake Bakery
Primary request: Create one French macaron seen from the front, slightly from above: two smooth domed shells with a ruffled foot, a thick white cream filling between them, and a soft highlight on the top shell. Match the existing topper-heart reference image's illustration style: cute polished candy-colour game art, bold dark navy #24163f outline, soft cel shading, glossy highlights.
Composition/framing: Isolated centered object filling most of a 112×96 landscape canvas; whole macaron visible. The lowest point of the macaron touches the exact bottom-center canvas edge with absolutely no transparent padding below, because it attaches to cake there. Transparent pixels around it. Keep proportions compact and front-facing.
Color palette: shell pink #ff9fd0 as the main tinted region; cream filling white; small navy outline and soft white highlights. Main shell should be predominantly pink so code hue rotation affects the shells only.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no extra objects, no border, no crop, no flame.
